messages:
Marco: Heads up — HarborCare (acct HC-221) has INV-2026-1123 past due: $23,410. Customer emailed asking to avoid suspension and proposed a 4-month split. Posting notes here.

Sana: Thanks — got the note. Do we have an active PO or updated billing contact? They said billing@harborcarehealth.org and referenced PO-HC-77.

Olivia: Support confirms PO-HC-77 received. Payment method on file = ACH (R01 from 2024). They also opened a usage dispute for 01/10 high-inference batch; ticket #3054.

Marco: Customer offered 25% now, then 25% x3 monthly. Proposed no suspension while on plan. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Derek: I'm ok with a 4-month plan if there's a signed agreement + auto-debit mandate. Require a small administrative fee ($150) to cover processing. If dispute resolves in our favor, remaining balance becomes due immediately.

legal-bot: Clause suggestion (from counsel):
```
- Customer agrees to immediate acceleration of outstanding balance if audit upholds disputed charges.
- HarborCare must provide valid PO and sign payment plan within 5 business days.
- Non-payment on any installment permits service suspension after 3 business days' notice.
```
Please confirm before sending.

Sana: Ok to include those. Also recommend capping disputed amount at $2,500 pending audit. We don't want open-ended disputes.

collections-bot: Automated dunning schedule: next reminder email 1799993600. If no payment received by 1799997200, escalate to senior collections.

Olivia: Support uploaded the job logs and labeled job 9987 as "scheduled batch" not manual. Jordan is OOO, but I pulled logs — may be legitimate. We should run audit before committing credit.

Marco: I'm going to draft the DocuSign + ACH authorization and send to billing@harborcarehealth.org. Draft terms: 25% now ($5,852.50), then 25% on day 30/60/90. Admin fee $150. Disputed amount capped $2,500 pending audit. No suspension while payments current.

Derek: Add a fallback: if first payment fails to clear within 5 business days, we cancel the plan and re-open escalation. Also include a digital signature requirement.

Sana: Sent DocuSign link and Stripe invoice for first installment. Updating AR ledger: HC-221-PAYPLAN. Will monitor ACH.

Olivia: Ticket #3054 assigned to audit team. ETA 3 business days. Will post results here.

Marco: Great. If I don't see first payment by EOD Friday, I'll escalate to the senior manager. Thanks all.
